faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Have questions about hardware, setup, or features? Here are clear answers.
faq.q1: How does pairing a TV screen work?
faq.a1: Install the ABSignage app on your TV or Android Box. When you open it, a 6-digit pairing code appears on screen. Open your ABSignage web dashboard on your computer or phone, enter the code, and your TV is instantly connected.
faq.q2: What happens if the internet connection is lost?
faq.a2: Your TVs never go black. All videos, images, and playlists are cached locally in the device's storage. Even if the internet disconnects for days, the TV continues playing seamlessly. When connectivity returns, it automatically syncs any updates.
faq.q3: Do I need to buy expensive commercial screens?
faq.a3: No. ABSignage works on standard Android TVs, Google TVs, and any normal TV equipped with an affordable Android TV Box or HDMI Stick (costing around $30). You can use your existing televisions without replacing them.
faq.q4: How does split-screen and multi-zone support work?
faq.a4: In your playlist manager, you can choose whether content plays in Fullscreen (100%) or in a multi-zone layout: Dual Split (50/50) or Triple Split (33%/33%/33%) in both Horizontal and Vertical orientations.
faq.q5: Can I manage screens in different branches or cities?
faq.a5: Yes. The dashboard is 100% cloud-based. You can group screens by city, store, or room, and push updates to one screen, a selected group, or all screens simultaneously with a single click.
faq.q6: Can I try ABSignage before subscribing?
faq.a6: Yes. We offer a full 14-day free trial so you can connect your screens, test your playlists, and experience the platform with zero risk and no credit card required.

howItWorks.title: One Platform. Every Business. Every Screen.
howItWorks.subtitle: From restaurants and cafes to retail stores, fashion brands, and beauty businesses, ABSignage makes it easy to manage your digital screens. Connect your TVs, upload your content, create playlists, and publish campaigns — all from one powerful platform.
howItWorks.downloadAppText: Install the official ABSignage Player app for free on Android TV or Google TV:

scenes.title: Scene 1 — Pairing Code Generation on Android TV
scenes.desc: The ABSignage Android TV app launches and automatically generates a unique 6-digit pairing code (739-204), waiting for the platform connection.

scenes.title: Scene 2 — Enter Pairing Code into ABSignage Platform
scenes.desc: The user opens the ABSignage web console, navigates to Devices, and enters the exact same 6-digit code (739-204) shown on the TV.

scenes.title: Scene 3 — Successful Pairing & TV Activation
scenes.desc: The platform confirms pairing instantly. The TV registers as Online & Active, ready to receive playlists and campaigns.

scenes.title: Scene 4 — Upload Commercial Images & Videos
scenes.desc: Upload professional 4K images and videos across food, beverages, cosmetics, fashion collections, and retail promotions in one centralized hub.

scenes.title: Scene 5 — Create Different Playlist Formats
scenes.desc: Choose the perfect layout: Full-screen (100% display), Horizontal Multi-Zone (3 synchronized zones), or Vertical Totem (9:16) for retail pillars.

scenes.title: Scene 6 — Select & Organize Media Inside Playlists
scenes.desc: Assign media from the library to zones, set display durations (10s, 15s) and smooth transitions with interactive real-time TV preview.

scenes.title: Scene 7 — Create & Configure Campaign (Campaign → Playlist → TV)
scenes.desc: Connect the workflow: CAMPAIGN ──▶ PLAYLIST ──▶ TV DEVICE. Hit Publish and the cloud network pushes the update to your screen instantly.

scenes.title: Scene 8 — Campaign Playing on Android TV across Multiple Environments
scenes.desc: The TV plays the published campaign across restaurants, bars, cosmetics stores, and fashion boutiques. One platform for every business.

privacy.badge: Google Play Policy Compliant · GDPR & COPPA Ready
privacy.title: Privacy Policy for ABSignage Player
privacy.noticeText: This Privacy Policy applies directly to the ABSignage Android TV Player application, the ABSignage Management Console, and associated backend cloud APIs developed by ABSignage.
privacy.s1P1: At ABSignage, we respect your privacy and are committed to full transparency in accordance with Google Play's User Data Policy, European Union GDPR, and applicable global privacy regulations.
privacy.s1P2: ABSignage Player is a business-to-business (B2B) digital signage client designed for TV screens, digital menu boards, and commercial displays. We never sell personal data and only collect minimum technical data necessary for screen synchronization.
privacy.s2Title: 2. Data We Collect and How We Use It
privacy.b1Text: A pseudonymous ID generated during pairing to link the TV screen with your organization's dashboard.
privacy.b2Text: Screen online status, frame rate, and cache storage size to ensure continuous playback without black screens.
privacy.sharingP1: We do not sell personal data, and we do not share it with advertisers or data brokers. The player contains no advertising SDK and no third-party analytics.
privacy.sharingP2: Data is processed only by the infrastructure providers that operate the service on our behalf — application hosting, database hosting and transactional email delivery — strictly to run ABSignage. We disclose data to public authorities only where the law requires it.
privacy.retentionIntro: Retention is enforced by scheduled jobs, not by hand:
privacy.r1Text: kept for 10 days, then deleted automatically.
privacy.r2Text: kept for 30 days, then deleted automatically.
privacy.r3Text: kept for 400 days. They record who changed what, and they deliberately outlive the records they describe.
privacy.r4Text: removed 30 days after they are accepted, withdrawn or expired.
privacy.retentionP2: On a verified deletion request, account records, playlists, uploaded media and device telemetry are permanently purged within 30 days.
privacy.s3Desc: You have the right to request deletion of your account and all associated screens at any time.

terms.title: Terms of Service for ABSignage
terms.noticeText: These Terms of Service ("Terms") govern your access to and use of the ABSignage Android TV Player application (Google Play Package ID: com.andibevapi.digitalsignageplayer), the ABSignage Cloud Management Console, and associated cloud APIs operated by ABSignage.
terms.s1P1: By downloading, installing, or launching the ABSignage Player application from Google Play, pairing a television display, or registering an account on the ABSignage Cloud Console, you ("Customer", "Organization", or "User") agree to be bound by these Terms of Service.
terms.s1P2: ABSignage is a Business-to-Business (B2B) cloud digital signage platform built for commercial environments—including restaurants, cafes, retail stores, supermarkets, pharmacies, clinics, hotels, fitness centers, and corporate offices—running on Android TV, Google TV, and Android TV Boxes or HDMI Sticks.
terms.s2Intro: Subject to your compliance with these Terms and your active subscription tier, ABSignage grants your organization a limited, non-exclusive, non-transferable, revocable license to install and run the ABSignage Player app on your commercial displays and access the web dashboard.
terms.s2B1Text: You may pair and manage TV screens up to the screen limit of your selected plan (Start, Business 5, Business 10, Pro 20, Chain 50, or Enterprise).
terms.s2B2Text: You may not reverse-engineer, decompile, disassemble, modify, or redistribute the ABSignage Player APK, nor attempt to bypass the 6-digit pairing authentication or cloud rate limits.
terms.s2B3Text: Installation and automatic updates distributed via Google Play Store are subject to Google Play's Terms of Service alongside this agreement.
terms.s3Intro: To deliver uninterrupted commercial broadcasting without black screens, the ABSignage Player app performs specific local and cloud operations on your paired TV hardware:
terms.s3B1Text: Upon launch, the TV app generates a unique 6-digit pairing code to link the physical display with your organization's cloud dashboard.
terms.s3B2Text: You authorize the application to download and cache your scheduled 4K videos, images, and multi-zone layouts in the device's local storage so playback continues seamlessly even during multi-day internet outages.
terms.s3B3Text: The player transmits periodic technical heartbeats (online/offline status, active playlist state, FPS, and free storage capacity) to your dashboard for real-time monitoring and diagnostics.
terms.s4Title: 4. Customer Media, Intellectual Property & Acceptable Use
terms.s4Intro: ABSignage provides tools for uploading images and 4K videos, building Fullscreen, Dual Split (50/50), and Triple Split (33%) multi-zone layouts, and scheduling day-parting campaigns.
terms.s4B1Text: You retain 100% ownership and intellectual property rights over all logos, menus, photos, price lists, and promotional videos uploaded to your ABSignage Media Library.
terms.s4B2Text: You represent and warrant that you own or hold valid commercial licenses for all media uploaded and publicly displayed on your paired screens.
terms.s4B3Text: You must not upload or broadcast unlawful, defamatory, copyright-infringing, sexually explicit, hateful, deceptive, or malicious content, nor use the platform in violation of applicable advertising or public display laws.
terms.s5Intro: ABSignage offers transparent, scalable pricing based on the number of managed TV screens, available on Monthly or Annual billing cycles (with 2 months free on annual plans):
terms.s5B1Text: New organizations may test the platform for 14 days free of charge with no credit card required. If you choose not to subscribe after the trial, screen broadcasting simply pauses without automatic charges.
terms.s5B2Text: Plans scale from Start (1 TV), Business 5 (up to 5 TVs), Business 10 (up to 10 TVs), Pro 20 (up to 20 TVs), and Chain 50 (up to 50 TVs) up to Enterprise (Unlimited TVs with 99.99% SLA uptime).
terms.s5B3Text: You may upgrade your screen capacity or cancel your subscription at any time. Cancellation stops future billing cycles while allowing access through the end of your current paid period.
terms.s6P1: ABSignage utilizes redundant cloud infrastructure and AES-256 encryption to maintain high availability (up to 99.99% SLA for Enterprise fleets), reinforced by local device caching so local screens continue running even if external networks fail.
terms.s6P2: Customers are responsible for maintaining their physical TV displays, Android TV Boxes/Sticks, power supply, and local mounting safety. We may release automatic software updates via Google Play to improve playback performance, security, and multi-zone capabilities.
terms.s7Title: 7. Data Privacy, GDPR & Account Deletion Rights
terms.s7P1: Your privacy and data security are governed by our Privacy Policy in strict compliance with the Google Play User Data Policy and European Union GDPR. We never sell customer data or display third-party ads on your screens.
terms.s7P2: You may unpair devices, remove media assets, or submit a permanent Account & Data Deletion request at any time. Upon verification, all account records, playlists, uploaded media, and device telemetry are permanently purged within 30 days.
terms.s8P1: To the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, ABSignage shall not be liable for indirect, incidental, consequential, or hardware-related damages arising from local power failures, third-party television hardware defects, or unauthorized screen content uploaded by users.
terms.s8P2: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate accounts that materially breach these Terms, abuse cloud infrastructure, or broadcast illegal content. For legal inquiries or enterprise agreements, please contact our team through the official ABSignage platform.
